note: The recurring cast of the daily cases. Initials are tool IDs. Bios never mention a place.

A.name: Ada Ashworth
A.bio: Retired codebreaker. Still does the crossword in ink.

B.name: Basil Blackwood
B.bio: Collector of antique clocks, always five minutes early.
B.catchphrase: Punctuality is a kind of alibi.

C.name: Cleo Carrow
C.bio: Botanist with a pocketful of seeds and a sharp eye.
C.catchphrase: Roots tell you where things have been.

D.name: Dorian Dale
D.bio: Stage magician who insists he has retired.

E.name: Esme Elwood
E.bio: Society columnist who hears everything first.

F.name: Felix Fairweather
F.bio: Ship's doctor with steady hands and a loud laugh.
F.catchphrase: Breathe in. Now tell me again.

G.name: Greta Gale
G.bio: Mountaineer who never sits still for long.

H.name: Hugo Hargreaves
H.bio: Librarian who can find any book, and any secret.

victims.name: Victor Vane
victims.bio: Heir to the Vane fortune, and to its bad luck.

victims.name: Vera Vane
victims.bio: Philanthropist with too many grateful friends.

victims.name: Violet Vane
victims.bio: Opera singer who never missed a curtain call, until now.

victims.name: Valentina Vane
victims.bio: Art dealer with a ledger of enemies.

victims.name: Vaughn Vane
victims.bio: Yachtsman, gambler, and the family's black sheep.

running_gag: The Vanes are the unluckiest family in fiction. Every case, another one.
